attempts.summary: Created a local CA "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (RSA-4096, self-signed, 10yr validity, proper CA basicConstraints/keyUsage) with key/cert stored in /etc/pki/os-comparison-ca/, installed its certificate into the AlmaLinux system trust store via /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ and update-ca-trust extract, and verified via `trust list` and end-to-end leaf-certificate verification (openssl verify against the default system trust bundle) that the CA is genuinely trusted. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, issued a background `shutdown -r now` whose ack returned before disconnect, confirmed the node dropped, polled until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed (d6298ced... -> 1c1541e1...) proving an actual restart, and re-verified post-restart that the CA trust anchor persisted on disk and that a freshly issued leaf certificate still verifies against the system trust store.
